{{one source |date=May 2024}}
In mathematics, an '''Enoki surface''' is [[compact space|compact]] [[complex number|complex]] [[surface (mathematics)|surface]] with positive second [[Betti number]] that has a [[global spherical shell]] and a non-trivial divisor ''D'' with ''H''<sup>0</sup>(O(''D''))&nbsp;≠&nbsp;0 and (''D'',&nbsp;''D'')&nbsp;=&nbsp;0. {{harvtxt|Enoki|1980}} constructed some examples. They are [[surfaces of class VII]], so are non-Kähler and have [[Kodaira dimension]] &minus;∞.
